title: Sump pump motor, earth fault from wet terminal box
tests: Thin notes; messy; forced vs natural unclear; evidence missing.
summary: A pit sump pump motor tripped on earth fault and the terminal box was wet. Notes and evidence are minimal. Tests that the AI asks for evidence and does not conclude.

problem.title: Earth fault on pit sump pump motor
problem.site: Open cut coal mine, Bowen Basin QLD
problem.whatHappened: Motor on the pit sump pump tripped on earth fault after heavy rain. Terminal box was wet inside.
problem.impact: Sump filled until a spare pump was fitted.

evidence.title: Terminal box
evidence.note: Water inside, tracking on the terminal block, cable gland perished.

tree.text: Earth fault trip on pit sump pump motor M-7107

problemDraft.roughNotes: m7107 earth fault trip after the rain last night. terminal box full of water. dried it out, megger was low so we replaced the motor. cable gland looked old.

mustSuggest.idea: Cable gland perished or wrong IP rating gland, allowing rain into the box
Box cover seal or drain breather failed
No inspection of glands and boxes on outdoor motors in the PM plan
Standard for outdoor installations in a pit area not defined (IP rating, gland type, cable entry)

wrongOrDangerous: Electrician failed to close the cover (blame, no evidence)

mustFlag.note: Gland ageing, forced or natural not decided
Flagged root has only a corrective action

mustNotFlag: stating the gland is the proven root
challenge.expectation: Short list of questions: how did the water get in, how many other outdoor motors?
deliberateWeaknesses: Only one cause node, no entry for how water got in
The only cause is flagged as root but is a hypothesis with no preventive action
e1 mentions the perished gland, not used in the tree
Deterioration of the gland (UV, age) not decided

capa.deteriorationReasoning: The gland is perished: that could be age and UV (natural) or the wrong gland type for the pit environment (forced). Check the gland type and date installed.

preventive.what: Inspect terminal box seal, gland and drain on outdoor motors and record megger readings
Specify gland and box IP rating for outdoor and pit duty and check at installation
Hold gland kits and a spare motor of this size

capa.spares: Motor or a terminal box and gland kit for the sump pump motor; no part numbers.
capa.rollout: Other pit dewatering motors and outdoor motors in the same area.
unacceptable: Declaring natural or forced with confidence
Inventing a megger value or IP rating
